title: Battery Cell Simulation Engineer
description:
**What to Expect**
We are seeking a Cell Simulation Engineer to work across cell teams, organizing and processing lithium\-ion cell data to support critical design and analysis decisions. You will develop and maintain visually rich, data\-driven tools that inform engineers across the company and optimize Li\-ion cell models for electric vehicles and energy products. You will optimize model parameters to best predict empirical battery data, write test plans, propose design of experiments, and summarize results in test reports. You will also use data manipulation and visualization skills to convey model and test results to fellow engineers, follow up on inquiries, and disseminate bleeding\-edge results traceably and reproducibly.

 **What You'll Do**
* Process and analyze large\-scale simulation and experimental datasets using MATLAB, Python, or similar tools
* Optimize model parameters to accurately predict empirical battery performance
* Develop automated reporting and visualization frameworks to convey model and test results
* Collaborate with Cell Engineers to support cell design, analysis, and electrochemical modeling
* Write test plans, design experiments (DOE), and summarize findings in technical reports
* Maintain high\-level metrics linking simulation data to electrochemical models
* Support cross\-functional teams with data requests and disseminate research findings efficiently
* Document model workflows, implementations, and simulation study results
  

**What You'll Bring**
* Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience
* Expert\-level programming and data analysis skills in MATLAB or Python
* Strong data visualization capabilities
* Excellent analytical and organizational skills
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment
* Excellent interpersonal and collaboration skills; ability to work patiently and effectively with engineers across multiple disciplines and teams
* Experience with MySQ

In this role you will guide and direct the technical activities of the team across key kernel subsystems — Memory Management, Scheduler, Power Management — and own the Quality Assurance practices that ensure this work is upstream-ready and production-quality. Your team's scope also includes pre-silicon validation of new AMD hardware, performance optimization, and both internal and customer debug. You will bring an understanding of computer architecture and operating system concepts for the x86-64 architecture, drive feature design and development in the Linux kernel and related open source projects, and help bring new generations of AMD hardware to market. This is a highly collaborative role: you will work closely with remote engineering staff across India, the U.S., and Europe to set direction, remove obstacles, and grow the careers of the engineers you lead.
